svg.title: Equipotentials and field lines of two equal negative charges
svg.desc: (a) Equipotential lines as they might be measured in the laboratory: a small circle at −10 V around each of two points, a dumbbell-shaped line at −5 V enclosing both, and a larger oval at −2 V around everything. (b) The same equipotentials with the field lines drawn perpendicular to them. The field lines come in from all directions and end on two equal negative charges, one at the center of each −10 V circle; none run between the charges.
